name: Mate Soos
description: Mate Soos works at the intersection of industry and academia. He received his PhD from INP Grenoble in 2009 and has worked in IT security and privacy since. In the Ethereum ecosystem since 2022, he spent 3 years at the Ethereum Foundation and now works at the Argot Collective on fuzzing the Solidity compiler and symbolic execution of smart contracts. He also spends time most years at the University of Toronto and the National University of Singapore, researching SAT solving and model counting.
